name: Quick Pro UR:ONE
why_interesting: A lightweight road build pairing a 629 g claimed frame with Dura-Ace Di2 and a current official global price.
missing: Dated mainland-China RMB checkout observation and purchase route
Mainland delivery, duties, returns, and warranty-handling confirmation
source_note: Official global-store price US$6,899. Approximate CNY reference uses the 2026-07-31 CFETS central parity rate; it excludes card FX, shipping, tax and duties and is not a mainland checkout quote. A public owner build claims 6.5 kg, while heavier paint and wheels reportedly move builds above 7 kg; one disc-mount surface issue and seatpost-slip sensitivity are owner-specific reports.
support_note: Official support page states a five-year frameset warranty for the original purchaser, one-year Shimano/SRAM coverage on complete bikes, mostly assembled delivery, and typical standard-bike delivery around three weeks; mainland-China service and delivery are not confirmed.
